items.title: Everything in Arabic
items.text: Home, the spotlight, Discover, Similar, the Library and the screensaver: names, posters, logos and descriptions in Arabic or English, from TMDB.

items.title: Search in Arabic
items.text: Type a name in Arabic or English: suggestions and results come in your language.

items.title: Picks that fit
items.text: Watch something similar shows TMDB's recommendations for that very title.

items.title: Fixes install themselves
items.text: Small updates install quietly while the TV is left alone, so you always have the latest fixes.
